title: GG ATHLETIC™ Everyday Tee
_source: Copy, sizes and prices copied verbatim from Shopify draft 10249996501184 (read 2026-10-27).
description_html:
FAITH IN MOTION.™

GG ATHLETIC™ is clean, premium GOD GEAR™ built to move — everyday apparel carrying the FAITH IN MOTION.™ identity.

GOD IS MY SOURCE!

Details

  • Unisex heavyweight tee, Black
  • GOD GEAR™ wordmark on the front; GG mark on the back
  • Made to order

Fabric, weight and size measurements are published once the heavyweight garment passes GOD GEAR™ sample certification. See the Size guide.

Care

  • Machine wash cold, inside out
  • Tumble dry low or hang dry
  • Do not iron directly on the print
  • Do not dry clean
_allowed_models_note: BMW: Bella+Canvas 3001 replaced. Only Comfort Colors 1717 (the heavyweight already accepted on live GG ACTIVE) is allowed. Changing this list requires a reviewed commit.
_back_art_note: No print-ready GG mark exists in custody (GG-master-logo.jpg is a 1086x1448 concept JPG). Back print disabled until one does.
